csv_scope_of_work: The Ashland County Airport Authority is soliciting engineering/consulting services proposals from qualified firms to assist in airport development projects. Projects are anticipated to be initiated between 2026-2031. The SOQ should demonstrate the consultants interest in providing airport planning, architectural / engineering design, and construction administration services focused on the current Airport Capital Improvements.
